data.name: Weapon Master Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Start with a small workshop and turn it into a fully equipped weapon development, customization, and retail business.

In this detailed simulation game, you disassemble weapons part by part, repair, upgrade, paint, and test them at the shooting range before putting them up for sale. Every component affects performance — from barrel to trigger, from coating to optics — every decision changes accuracy, recoil handling, and customer satisfaction.

You can also sell equipment such as armor, ammunition, accessories, pepper spray, special clothing, and hunting gear.

Criminal organizations may want to cooperate with you. You can accept or reject their offers — but remember, if you work with them, the police will be watching. Cooperation comes with risks.

Weapon Repair & Development

  • Fully disassemble weapons and inspect their internal mechanics

  • Identify and replace damaged parts

  • Restore old weapons or upgrade them for higher performance

Customization & Painting

  • Swap parts such as barrels, grips, stocks, scopes, magazines, and suppressors

  • Apply custom patterns, paints, and coatings

  • Decorate weapons with accessories

  • Design weapons focused on aesthetics or performance

  • Create unique weapons and meet customer requests for full satisfaction

Shooting Range & Testing

Test your weapons before selling them:

  • Measure accuracy and bullet spread

  • Evaluate recoil and stability

  • Try different types of ammunition

  • Upgrade your shooting range and earn certifications

Test results directly affect weapon quality and market value.

Store Management & Equipment Sales

Manage your own shop:

  • Set prices

  • Manage inventory

  • Fulfill customer demands

  • Accept weapons from customers for customization

  • Complete special orders

Sell not only weapons, but also:

  • Steel vests and ballistic armor

  • Gas masks

  • Bulletproof tactical clothing

  • Optics and accessories

Progression & Growth

  • Unlock new tools and materials

  • Take on more difficult and valuable orders

  • Expand your workshop and shooting range

  • Increase your reputation to attract premium customers

  • Build relationships with weapon syndicates

Key Features

  • Detailed part-based weapon system

  • Advanced customization and painting tools

  • Unique and previously unseen weapon customization options

  • Realistic shooting range and performance testing

  • Store and customer management systems

  • Equipment, accessories, and armor sales system
